episodes.synopsis: Kunato Hyoma, who harbors a hatred for tsukumogami, is forced to live with a house full of them and their enigmatic mistress, Nagatsuki Botan.
episodes.title: Hyoma

episodes.synopsis: A bad first impression threatens to get Hyoma kicked out of his new home after only three days if he can't win over his tsukumogami hosts.
episodes.title: Shoreline

episodes.synopsis: Hyoma has one more tsukumogami's support to earn before he'll be allowed to stay in the Nagatsuki household... but Yu seems completely unyielding.
episodes.title: Overflow

episodes.synopsis: Having earned his right to remain in the Nagatsuki residence for a year, Hyoma learns about the ulterior motive behind his stay.
episodes.title: Arrangement

episodes.synopsis: An overly cautious Hyoma is forced to remove protective talismans he set up around the town, and learns more about Nagatsuki Botan in the process.
episodes.title: Suspicions

episodes.synopsis: After his cryptic encounter with Aogi, Hyoma is determined to learn more about Botan. Haori is happy to explain, if only he'll be willing to listen...
episodes.title: Botan

episodes.synopsis: Hyoma visits the Saenome of Kyoto, the Kadomori Clan, to get permission to act on their territory. But the Kadomoris have their own intentions...
episodes.title: Quickening

episodes.synopsis: A curveball thrown at Hyoma by Kadomori Taiju forces him to confront some of the ways he's changed.
episodes.title: Circumstances

episodes.synopsis: Hyoma teams up with Yu and Tsubaki to fight a gang of tsukumogami who've begun targeting Kadomoris for torture.
episodes.title: Fire

episodes.synopsis: Tsubaki makes Hyoma an offer he might not be able to refuse, and the Nagatsuki tsukumogami hold a party.
episodes.title: Radiance

episodes.synopsis: Hyoma looks into acquiring some better defenses, but acquiring Saenome armor requires him to pass a test.
episodes.title: Ambush

episodes.synopsis: The battle with Kai reveals secrets that the Nagatsukis would rather leave unknown.
episodes.title: Efflorescence
